headline: Earnings and margins climb on a tariff-refund tailwind
summary_short: Strongest June quarter ever, with double-digit growth across iPhone, Mac and Services. Gross margin at 50.1% included ~2 points of tariff-refund benefit; adjusted EPS +$0.11 from the same tailwind.
summary_long: Gross margin at 50.1% included roughly 2 percentage points of favorable tariff-refund impact the release calls out explicitly. Diluted EPS included a $0.11 tariff-refund benefit — factor both out when comparing margin/EPS trend to prior quarters. Capital returns (9-month YTD): $62.09B in buybacks and $11.78B in dividends paid. The board declared a $0.27/share cash dividend payable August 13, 2026 to shareholders of record Aug 11. The release contains no forward revenue or EPS guidance.

drivers.explanation: CEO cited the strongest June quarter ever, with double-digit revenue growth across iPhone, Mac and Services and every geographic segment; CFO cited record EPS and operating cash flow.
Company states gross margin included approximately 2 percentage points of favorable impact from tariff refunds this quarter.
Company states diluted EPS growth included a $0.11 favorable impact from tariff refunds.
